fullDocumentReview.independent_audit: Original main-only source audit and R2 targeted source correction recheck passed within their recorded scopes. A separate current integration reviewer checked the four canonical records, material/solution/product bindings, 23 reused chemical models, source figure assignments and narrowly qualified morphology display. Clean release/deployment verification is a separate gate. SI remains unverified.
